name: Swami Vivekananda Merit-cum-Means Scholarship (SVMCM) — West Bengal
source_organization: Higher Education Department, Govt of West Bengal
description: For meritorious students who live in West Bengal and study in a West Bengal institution in regular mode (Class 11-12, UG, PG, professional, research). Family income up to ₹2.5 lakh. Minimum marks: 60% in the last exam for Higher Secondary and UG; 53% for PG (55% for engineering PG); 45% for Kanyashree K3 girls (no income limit). You must not take any other government scholarship. The 2026-27 fresh last date was not announced when this was checked; renewal was reported as 31 Dec 2026. The document list below may be shorter than the portal's.
benefits: ₹1,000–8,000 a month depending on the course (per scheme summaries — confirm on the portal).
